headline: American Tower or Crown Castle? Wall Street’s Clear Pick Between Beaten-Down Tower REITs
summary: Both cell-tower REITs are trading near one-year lows, and both look cheap on the surface, but one hides a yield trap that could quietly drain a retirement portfolio while the other just raised guidance for the second time this year.

headline: How Record CoreSite Leasing And Strong Q2 Results At American Tower (AMT) Have Changed Its Investment Story
summary: American Tower Corporation recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, with revenue rising to US$2,749.1 million and net income reaching US$867.5 million, alongside higher earnings per share versus a year earlier. The company also raised its full-year 2026 outlook, highlighting record leasing at its CoreSite data center business and stronger global tower activity as key earnings drivers. headline: BMO Capital Maintains Market Perform on American Tower, Raises Price Target to $195
summary: BMO Capital  analyst Ari Klein   maintains American Tower (NYSE:AMT) with a Market Perform and raises the price target from $190 to $195.
